# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Packages
# ------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(WGCNA)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(GO.db)
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# BACTERIAL DATA
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dds_micro <- readRDS(
  "PostKraken2/00_TempData/microbial_dds.rds"
)

vsd_micro <- readRDS("PostKraken2/00_TempData/microbial_vsd.rds")

micro_expr <- assay(vsd_micro)

cat("Bacterial genes:", nrow(micro_expr), "\n")
cat("Bacterial samples:", ncol(micro_expr), "\n")

head(colnames(micro_expr))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# HOST DATA
# ------------------------------------------------------------
dds_host <- readRDS("Host_DESEQ/microbial_dds.rds")

vsd_host <- readRDS("Host_DESEQ/microbial_vsd.rds")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# MATCH HOST AND BACTERIAL SAMPLES
# ============================================================

# Extract host metadata
metadata_host <- as.data.frame(colData(dds_host))

# Extract microbiome metadata
metadata_micro <- as.data.frame(colData(dds_micro))

# Host sample information
host_samples <- data.frame(
  HostSample = colnames(vsd_host),
  UrchinID = sub(
    "^[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*$",
    "\\1",
    colnames(vsd_host)
  ),
  Condition = metadata_host[colnames(vsd_host), "condition"]
)

# Microbiome sample information
micro_samples <- data.frame(
  MicroSample = colnames(vsd_micro),
  UrchinID = colnames(vsd_micro)
)

# Match by individual UrchinID
sample_map <- inner_join(
  host_samples,
  micro_samples,
  by = "UrchinID"
)

# Check matching
print(sample_map)
cat("\nMatched individuals:", nrow(sample_map), "\n")
table(sample_map$Condition)

# Reorder both matrices using the matched individuals
host_expr <- assay(vsd_host)[
  ,
  sample_map$HostSample,
  drop = FALSE
]

micro_expr <- assay(vsd_micro)[
  ,
  sample_map$MicroSample,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Give both matrices identical sample names
colnames(host_expr) <- sample_map$UrchinID
colnames(micro_expr) <- sample_map$UrchinID

# Verify pairing
stopifnot(identical(
  colnames(host_expr),
  colnames(micro_expr)
))

# Split by treatment
ref_samples <- sample_map$UrchinID[
  sample_map$Condition == "Reference"
]

co2_samples <- sample_map$UrchinID[
  sample_map$Condition == "Elevated CO2"
]

host_ref <- host_expr[, ref_samples, drop = FALSE]
micro_ref <- micro_expr[, ref_samples, drop = FALSE]

host_co2 <- host_expr[, co2_samples, drop = FALSE]
micro_co2 <- micro_expr[, co2_samples, drop = FALSE]

cat("\nReference samples:", length(ref_samples))
cat("\nElevated CO2 samples:", length(co2_samples))

cat("\n\nReference dimensions:")
print(dim(host_ref))
print(dim(micro_ref))

cat("\nElevated CO2 dimensions:")
print(dim(host_co2))
print(dim(micro_co2))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# PREPARE WGCNA INPUTS
# ============================================================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# WGCNA requires samples in rows and genes in columns
datExpr_host <- t(host_expr)
datExpr_micro <- t(micro_expr)

# Check dimensions
cat("Host WGCNA input:", dim(datExpr_host), "\n")
cat("Bacterial WGCNA input:", dim(datExpr_micro), "\n")

# Check that sample order is identical
stopifnot(identical(
  rownames(datExpr_host),
  rownames(datExpr_micro)
))

# Check for missing values
sum(is.na(datExpr_host))
sum(is.na(datExpr_micro))

# Check for duplicated feature names
anyDuplicated(colnames(datExpr_host))
anyDuplicated(colnames(datExpr_micro))
```

# Filter features before network construction
```{r}

# ============================================================
# WGCNA: SAMPLE AND GENE QUALITY CONTROL
# ============================================================

# Check sample and gene quality
gsg_host <- goodSamplesGenes(datExpr_host, verbose = 3)
gsg_micro <- goodSamplesGenes(datExpr_micro, verbose = 3)

# Retain all samples and genes passing quality control
datExpr_host <- datExpr_host[
  gsg_host$goodSamples,
  gsg_host$goodGenes,
  drop = FALSE
]

datExpr_micro <- datExpr_micro[
  gsg_micro$goodSamples,
  gsg_micro$goodGenes,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Retain all quality-controlled host genes and bacterial ORFs
# No additional variance-based filtering

cat("Host genes retained:", ncol(datExpr_host), "\n")
cat("Bacterial ORFs retained:", ncol(datExpr_micro), "\n")

cat("Matched samples:", nrow(datExpr_host), "\n")

# Confirm sample numbers match between datasets
stopifnot(
  identical(rownames(datExpr_host), rownames(datExpr_micro))
)

```

# Choosing soft thresholding power
```{r}
# ============================================================
# SOFT-THRESHOLDING POWER
# ============================================================

powers <- c(1:20)

# Host
sft_host <- pickSoftThreshold(
  datExpr_host,
  powerVector = powers,
  networkType = "unsigned",
  verbose = 5
)

# Bacteria
sft_micro <- pickSoftThreshold(
  datExpr_micro,
  powerVector = powers,
  networkType = "unsigned",
  verbose = 5
)

# Plot host scale-free topology fit
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

plot(
  sft_host$fitIndices[, 1],
  -sign(sft_host$fitIndices[, 3]) *
    sft_host$fitIndices[, 2],
  xlab = "Soft-thresholding power",
  ylab = "Scale-free topology fit (signed R²)",
  type = "n",
  main = "Host network"
)

text(
  sft_host$fitIndices[, 1],
  -sign(sft_host$fitIndices[, 3]) *
    sft_host$fitIndices[, 2],
  labels = powers
)

abline(h = 0.8, col = "red", lty = 2)

# Plot bacterial scale-free topology fit
plot(
  sft_micro$fitIndices[, 1],
  -sign(sft_micro$fitIndices[, 3]) *
    sft_micro$fitIndices[, 2],
  xlab = "Soft-thresholding power",
  ylab = "Scale-free topology fit (signed R²)",
  type = "n",
  main = "Bacterial network"
)

text(
  sft_micro$fitIndices[, 1],
  -sign(sft_micro$fitIndices[, 3]) *
    sft_micro$fitIndices[, 2],
  labels = powers
)

abline(h = 0.8, col = "red", lty = 2)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```


# Construct Host-Bacteria networks
```{r}
# ============================================================
# SET SOFT-THRESHOLDING POWERS
# ============================================================

softPower_host <- 6  
softPower_micro <- 7

# ============================================================
# CONSTRUCT HOST NETWORK
# ============================================================

host_net <- blockwiseModules(
  datExpr_host,
  power = softPower_host,
  networkType = "unsigned",
  TOMType = "unsigned",
  minModuleSize = 30,
  reassignThreshold = 0,
  mergeCutHeight = 0.25,
  numericLabels = TRUE,
  pamRespectsDendro = FALSE,
  saveTOMs = FALSE,
  verbose = 3
)

# ============================================================
# CONSTRUCT BACTERIAL NETWORK
# ============================================================

micro_net <- blockwiseModules(
  datExpr_micro,
  power = softPower_micro,
  networkType = "unsigned",
  TOMType = "unsigned",
  minModuleSize = 30,
  reassignThreshold = 0,
  mergeCutHeight = 0.25,
  numericLabels = TRUE,
  pamRespectsDendro = FALSE,
  saveTOMs = FALSE,
  verbose = 3
)

# Number of modules (excluding grey/unassigned features)
length(setdiff(unique(host_net$colors), 0))
length(setdiff(unique(micro_net$colors), 0))

# Number of features per module
table(host_net$colors)
table(micro_net$colors)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================

host_ME <- orderMEs(host_net$MEs)
micro_ME <- orderMEs(micro_net$MEs)

dim(host_ME)
dim(micro_ME)

head(host_ME)
head(micro_ME)

# Associate modules with CO2 condition
```{r}
# ============================================================
# SAMPLE TRAITS
# ============================================================

traits <- data.frame(
  Condition = ifelse(
    sample_map$Condition == "Elevated CO2",
    1,
    0
  )
)

rownames(traits) <- sample_map$UrchinID

# Ensure identical sample order
traits <- traits[rownames(host_ME), , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(
  rownames(traits),
  rownames(host_ME)
))

# ============================================================
# HOST MODULE - CONDITION CORRELATIONS
# ============================================================

host_trait_cor <- cor(
  host_ME,
  traits,
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

host_trait_p <- corPvalueStudent(
  host_trait_cor,
  nSamples = nrow(host_ME)
)

host_trait_results <- data.frame(
  Module = rownames(host_trait_cor),
  Correlation = as.numeric(host_trait_cor[, "Condition"]),
  Pvalue = as.numeric(host_trait_p[, "Condition"])
) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(Pvalue, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(FDR)

host_trait_results

# ============================================================
# BACTERIAL MODULE - CONDITION CORRELATIONS
# ============================================================

micro_trait_cor <- cor(
  micro_ME,
  traits,
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

micro_trait_p <- corPvalueStudent(
  micro_trait_cor,
  nSamples = nrow(micro_ME)
)

micro_trait_results <- data.frame(
  Module = rownames(micro_trait_cor),
  Correlation = as.numeric(micro_trait_cor[, "Condition"]),
  Pvalue = as.numeric(micro_trait_p[, "Condition"])
) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(Pvalue, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(FDR)

micro_trait_results
```

# Correlate host and bacterial modules
```{r}
# ============================================================
# HOST–BACTERIAL MODULE CORRELATIONS
# ============================================================

# Exclude grey/unassigned features (ME0)
host_ME_bio <- host_ME[
  , colnames(host_ME) != "ME0",
  drop = FALSE
]

micro_ME_bio <- micro_ME[
  , colnames(micro_ME) != "ME0",
  drop = FALSE
]

# Confirm matched individuals
stopifnot(
  identical(rownames(host_ME_bio), rownames(micro_ME_bio))
)

# Correlate host and bacterial module eigengenes
module_cor <- cor(
  host_ME_bio,
  micro_ME_bio,
  method = "pearson",
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

# Calculate P-values
module_p <- corPvalueStudent(
  module_cor,
  nSamples = nrow(host_ME_bio)
)

# Convert results to long format
module_results <- as.data.frame(
  as.table(module_cor)
) %>%
  rename(
    HostModule = Var1,
    MicroModule = Var2,
    Correlation = Freq
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Pvalue = as.vector(module_p),
    FDR = p.adjust(Pvalue, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(FDR)

# View all associations
module_results

# View significant associations
module_results %>%
  filter(FDR < 0.05)

# Number of significant associations
sum(module_results$FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
```

# Account for CO₂ treatment in host–bacterial correlations
```{r}
# ============================================================
# TREATMENT-ADJUSTED HOST–BACTERIAL MODULE CORRELATIONS
# ============================================================

# Remove grey modules
host_ME_bio <- host_ME[
  , colnames(host_ME) != "ME0",
  drop = FALSE
]

micro_ME_bio <- micro_ME[
  , colnames(micro_ME) != "ME0",
  drop = FALSE
]

# Regress each module eigengene against CO2 treatment
host_ME_resid <- sapply(
  colnames(host_ME_bio),
  function(m) {
    residuals(lm(host_ME_bio[, m] ~ traits$Condition))
  }
)

micro_ME_resid <- sapply(
  colnames(micro_ME_bio),
  function(m) {
    residuals(lm(micro_ME_bio[, m] ~ traits$Condition))
  }
)

# Correlate residual eigengenes
partial_cor <- cor(
  host_ME_resid,
  micro_ME_resid,
  method = "pearson",
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

# Calculate partial correlation P-values
n <- nrow(host_ME_bio)
df <- n - 3

partial_t <- partial_cor * sqrt(
  df / (1 - partial_cor^2)
)

partial_p <- 2 * pt(
  -abs(partial_t),
  df = df
)

# Adjust for multiple testing
partial_fdr <- matrix(
  p.adjust(as.vector(partial_p), method = "BH"),
  nrow = nrow(partial_p),
  ncol = ncol(partial_p),
  dimnames = dimnames(partial_p)
)

# Extract results
partial_results <- as.data.frame(
  as.table(partial_cor)
) %>%
  rename(
    HostModule = Var1,
    MicroModule = Var2,
    PartialCorrelation = Freq
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Pvalue = as.vector(partial_p),
    FDR = as.vector(partial_fdr)
  ) %>%
  arrange(FDR)

partial_results %>%
  filter(FDR < 0.05)

# Specifically inspect ME10–ME1
partial_results %>%
  filter(HostModule == "ME10", MicroModule == "ME1")
```

```{r}

# ============================================================
# MODULE–TREATMENT CORRELATION HEATMAP
# Combined host and microbiome WGCNA networks
# ============================================================

library(WGCNA)
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

host_ME_bio <- host_ME[, colnames(host_ME) != "ME0", drop = FALSE]
micro_ME_bio <- micro_ME[, colnames(micro_ME) != "ME0", drop = FALSE]

traits <- traits[rownames(host_ME_bio), , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(
  identical(rownames(host_ME_bio), rownames(micro_ME_bio)),
  identical(rownames(host_ME_bio), rownames(traits))
)

condition <- traits$Condition
n <- sum(complete.cases(condition))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Host module–treatment correlations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

host_cor <- cor(
  host_ME_bio,
  condition,
  method = "pearson",
  use = "complete.obs"
)

host_p <- corPvalueStudent(host_cor, nSamples = n)

# FDR correction within host modules only
host_fdr <- p.adjust(host_p, method = "BH")

names(host_cor) <- colnames(host_ME_bio)
names(host_fdr) <- colnames(host_ME_bio)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Microbiome module–treatment correlations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

micro_cor <- cor(
  micro_ME_bio,
  condition,
  method = "pearson",
  use = "complete.obs"
)

micro_p <- corPvalueStudent(micro_cor, nSamples = n)

# FDR correction within microbiome modules only
micro_fdr <- p.adjust(micro_p, method = "BH")

names(micro_cor) <- colnames(micro_ME_bio)
names(micro_fdr) <- colnames(micro_ME_bio)



# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Combine results for visualisation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

host_names <- colnames(host_ME_bio)
micro_names <- paste0("m_", colnames(micro_ME_bio))

# Explicitly preserve module names
names(host_cor) <- host_names
names(micro_cor) <- micro_names

names(host_fdr) <- host_names
names(micro_fdr) <- micro_names

names(host_p) <- host_names
names(micro_p) <- micro_names

module_names <- c(host_names, micro_names)

combined_cor <- c(
  as.numeric(host_cor),
  as.numeric(micro_cor)
)

combined_fdr <- c(
  as.numeric(host_fdr),
  as.numeric(micro_fdr)
)

combined_p <- c(
  as.numeric(host_p),
  as.numeric(micro_p)
)

names(combined_cor) <- module_names
names(combined_fdr) <- module_names
names(combined_p) <- module_names

heatmap_data <- matrix(
  combined_cor,
  ncol = 1,
  dimnames = list(module_names, "CO2 condition")
)

# Display coefficients only for FDR-significant modules
display_data <- matrix(
  "",
  nrow = length(combined_cor),
  ncol = 1,
  dimnames = dimnames(heatmap_data)
)

significant <- combined_fdr < 0.05

display_data[significant, 1] <- sprintf(
  "%.2f",
  combined_cor[significant]
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Annotate datasets
# ------------------------------------------------------------

row_annotation <- data.frame(
  Dataset = factor(
    c(
      rep("Host", length(host_names)),
      rep("Microbiome", length(micro_names))
    ),
    levels = c("Host", "Microbiome")
  ),
  row.names = module_names
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Plot combined heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------

library(grid)

p <- pheatmap(
  heatmap_data,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),
  display_numbers = display_data,
  number_color = "black",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  annotation_row = row_annotation,
  gaps_row = length(host_names),
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Module eigengene associations with CO2 condition",
  angle_col = 0,
  fontsize = 10,
  fontsize_number = 9,
  cellwidth = 90,
  cellheight = 15,
  legend = TRUE
)

# Add rho as the colour-scale title
grid.text(
  expression(rho),
  x = unit(0.96, "npc"),
  y = unit(0.82, "npc"),
  gp = gpar(fontsize = 11)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Export results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

host_results <- data.frame(
  Module = host_names,
  Dataset = "Host",
  Correlation = as.numeric(host_cor),
  Pvalue = as.numeric(host_p),
  FDR = as.numeric(host_fdr)
)

micro_results <- data.frame(
  Module = micro_names,
  Dataset = "Microbiome",
  Correlation = as.numeric(micro_cor),
  Pvalue = as.numeric(micro_p),
  FDR = as.numeric(micro_fdr)
)

combined_results <- bind_rows(host_results, micro_results)

write.csv(
  combined_results,
  "WGCNA/Combined_module_CO2_correlations.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Check all modules are present
print(heatmap_data)
print(combined_results %>% filter(FDR < 0.05))

```


```{r}

# ============================================================
# HOST–MICROBIOME MODULE EIGENGENE CORRELATION HEATMAP
# Modules annotated by association with CO2 treatment
# ============================================================
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Exclude grey/unassigned modules
host_ME_bio <- host_ME[, colnames(host_ME) != "ME0", drop = FALSE]
micro_ME_bio <- micro_ME[, colnames(micro_ME) != "ME0", drop = FALSE]

# Align treatment metadata
traits <- traits[rownames(host_ME_bio), , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(
  identical(rownames(host_ME_bio), rownames(micro_ME_bio)),
  identical(rownames(host_ME_bio), rownames(traits))
)

condition <- traits$Condition
n <- sum(complete.cases(condition))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Host–microbiome module correlations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cor_cross <- cor(
  host_ME_bio,
  micro_ME_bio,
  method = "pearson",
  use = "complete.obs"
)

p_cross <- corPvalueStudent(
  cor_cross,
  nSamples = n
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Host module associations with CO2 treatment
# ------------------------------------------------------------

host_treatment_cor <- cor(
  host_ME_bio,
  condition,
  method = "pearson",
  use = "complete.obs"
)

host_treatment_p <- corPvalueStudent(
  host_treatment_cor,
  nSamples = n
)

# FDR correction within host modules
host_treatment_fdr <- p.adjust(
  host_treatment_p,
  method = "BH"
)

names(host_treatment_fdr) <- colnames(host_ME_bio)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Microbiome module associations with CO2 treatment
# ------------------------------------------------------------

micro_treatment_cor <- cor(
  micro_ME_bio,
  condition,
  method = "pearson",
  use = "complete.obs"
)

micro_treatment_p <- corPvalueStudent(
  micro_treatment_cor,
  nSamples = n
)

# FDR correction within microbiome modules
micro_treatment_fdr <- p.adjust(
  micro_treatment_p,
  method = "BH"
)

names(micro_treatment_fdr) <- colnames(micro_ME_bio)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Prepare module names and annotations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Prefix microbiome modules to distinguish them from host modules
host_names <- colnames(host_ME_bio)
micro_names <- paste0("m_", colnames(micro_ME_bio))

# Rename correlation matrix columns
colnames(cor_cross) <- micro_names
colnames(p_cross) <- micro_names

# Host annotation: significant or not significant for CO2
host_annotation <- data.frame(
  CO2_association = factor(
    ifelse(host_treatment_fdr < 0.05,
           "Significant", "Not significant"),
    levels = c("Significant", "Not significant")
  ),
  row.names = host_names
)

# Microbiome annotation: significant or not significant for CO2
micro_annotation <- data.frame(
  CO2_association = factor(
    ifelse(micro_treatment_fdr < 0.05,
           "Significant", "Not significant"),
    levels = c("Significant", "Not significant")
  ),
  row.names = micro_names
)

# Check annotation alignment
stopifnot(
  identical(rownames(host_annotation), rownames(cor_cross)),
  identical(rownames(micro_annotation), colnames(cor_cross))
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Display significant cross-domain correlations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Display correlation coefficients only where P < 0.05
display_data <- matrix(
  "",
  nrow = nrow(cor_cross),
  ncol = ncol(cor_cross),
  dimnames = dimnames(cor_cross)
)

display_data[p_cross < 0.05] <- sprintf(
  "%.2f",
  cor_cross[p_cross < 0.05]
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Annotation colours
# ------------------------------------------------------------

annotation_colours <- list(
  CO2_association = c(
    "Significant" = "#E6AB02",
    "Not significant" = "#E6E6E6"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Plot and save heatmap as SVG
# ------------------------------------------------------------

p_cross_heatmap <- pheatmap(
  cor_cross,

  color = colorRampPalette(
  c("#2166AC", "white", "#c92f2aff")
)(100),

  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),

  display_numbers = display_data,
  number_color = "black",
  fontsize_number = 8,

  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,

  annotation_row = host_annotation,
  annotation_col = micro_annotation,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colours,

  annotation_names_row = FALSE,
  annotation_names_col = FALSE,

  border_color = "grey75",

  main = "Host–microbiome module eigengene correlations",

  angle_col = 45,
  fontsize = 9,
  cellwidth = 22,
  cellheight = 13,

  legend = TRUE,

  silent = TRUE
)

# Display heatmap in R
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(p_cross_heatmap$gtable)

# Save as SVG
svglite::svglite(
  "WGCNA/Host_Microbiome_Module_Correlation_Heatmap.svg",
  width = 4,
  height = 6
)

Numerical values are displayed for statistically significant host–microbiome correlations (P < 0.05). Annotations along the respective axes indicate modules significantly associated with CO₂ treatment (Reference versus Elevated CO₂; Benjamini–Hochberg-adjusted FDR < 0.05). # Host modules correlated with microbiome modules contained genes annotated to...?
```{r}

# ============================================================
# HOST: GSEA OF CORRELATED MODULES
# ============================================================
# Host modules correlated with microbiome modules
host_modules_to_test <- c("10")

# ============================================================
# 1. PREPARE GENE-LEVEL ANNOTATION MAPPING
# ============================================================

annotations <- annotations %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = str_remove(query_name, "\\.t\\d+$")
  )

# GO BP background
host_universe_GO <- intersect(
  str_remove(colnames(datExpr_host), "\\.t\\d+$"),
  unique(TERM2GENE_BP$gene)
)

cat(
  "Host WGCNA genes with GO BP annotations:",
  length(host_universe_GO), "\n"
)

# ============================================================
# 2. RUN GSEA FOR EACH CORRELATED HOST MODULE
# ============================================================

host_GSEA_results <- bind_rows(

  lapply(host_modules_to_test, function(module_id) {

    ME_name <- paste0("ME", module_id)

    if (!ME_name %in% colnames(host_ME)) {
      stop("Cannot find ", ME_name, " in host_ME.")
    }

    cat("\nRunning GSEA for", ME_name, "\n")

    # Calculate kME for every WGCNA transcript
    kME_values <- as.numeric(
      cor(
        datExpr_host,
        host_ME[, ME_name],
        use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
      )
    )

    names(kME_values) <- colnames(datExpr_host)

    # Convert WGCNA transcript IDs to gene IDs
    host_rank_df <- tibble(
      Transcript = names(kME_values),
      kME = kME_values
    ) %>%
      filter(is.finite(kME)) %>%
      mutate(
        Gene = str_remove(Transcript, "\\.t\\d+$")
      ) %>%
      filter(Gene %in% host_universe_GO) %>%
      group_by(Gene) %>%
      summarise(
        abs_kME = max(abs(kME), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      filter(is.finite(abs_kME)) %>%
      arrange(desc(abs_kME))

    # Ranked gene list
    geneList_host <- setNames(
      host_rank_df$abs_kME,
      host_rank_df$Gene
    )

    geneList_host <- sort(
      geneList_host,
      decreasing = TRUE
    )

    cat(
      "Genes in ranked list:",
      length(geneList_host), "\n"
    )

    # Check mapping before GSEA
    if (length(geneList_host) < 10) {
      warning(
        "Too few mapped genes for ", ME_name,
        ". Check gene ID matching."
      )
      return(NULL)
    }

    if (anyDuplicated(names(geneList_host))) {
      stop("Duplicate gene IDs in ranked list for ", ME_name)
    }

    # Run GSEA
    gsea_result <- clusterProfiler::GSEA(
      geneList = geneList_host,
      TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE_BP,
      TERM2NAME = TERM2NAME_BP,
      minGSSize = 5,
      maxGSSize = 500,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff = 1,
      verbose = FALSE,
      seed = TRUE
    )

    if (is.null(gsea_result)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    result_df <- as.data.frame(gsea_result)

    if (nrow(result_df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    result_df %>%
      mutate(
        Host_module = ME_name
      )

  })
)

# ============================================================
# 3. INSPECT AND EXPORT RESULTS
# ============================================================

if (nrow(host_GSEA_results) > 0) {

  # GSEA already applies BH correction across terms
  host_GSEA_results <- host_GSEA_results %>%
    arrange(p.adjust)

  host_GSEA_sig <- host_GSEA_results %>%
    filter(p.adjust < 0.05)

  cat(
    "\nSignificant GO BP terms:",
    nrow(host_GSEA_sig), "\n"
  )

  print(
    host_GSEA_sig %>%
      select(
        Host_module,
        ID,
        Description,
        setSize,
        enrichmentScore,
        NES,
        pvalue,
        p.adjust
      )
  )

  write.csv(
    host_GSEA_results,
    "Host_correlated_modules_GO_BP_GSEA.csv",
    row.names = FALSE
  )

} else {

  host_GSEA_sig <- tibble()

  message("No GSEA results returned.")

}

# ============================================================
# 4. GSEA DOT PLOT
# ============================================================

if (nrow(host_GSEA_sig) > 0) {

  plot_data <- host_GSEA_sig %>%
    group_by(Host_module) %>%
    slice_min(
      order_by = p.adjust,
      n = 21,
      with_ties = FALSE
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Description = str_wrap(Description, width = 45),
      LeadingEdgeSize = lengths(
        strsplit(core_enrichment, "/", fixed = TRUE)
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(Host_module) %>%
    arrange(NES, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      Plot_label = factor(
        paste0(Description, " [", ID, "]"),
        levels = unique(paste0(Description, " [", ID, "]"))
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  p_host_GSEA <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(x = NES, y = Plot_label)
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        size = LeadingEdgeSize,
        colour = -log10(p.adjust)
      ),
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ Host_module,
      scales = "free_y"
    ) +
    scale_colour_gradient(
      low = "#67A9CF",
      high = "#D73027",
      name = expression(-log[10](FDR))
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      range = c(2, 8),
      name = "Leading-edge genes"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Normalised enrichment score (NES)",
      y = NULL,
      title = "Biological processes associated with host modules",
      subtitle = "GO Biological Process GSEA using absolute module membership"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 9),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right",
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  print(p_host_GSEA)

  # Save as editable vector graphic
  ggsave(
    filename = "WGCNA/Host_GO_GSEA.svg",
    plot = p_host_GSEA,
    device = "svg",
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    units = "in",
    bg = "white"
  )
}

```

# Gene set enrichment analysis of biological processes associated with the host WGCNA module correlated with the microbiome module. Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) was performed using Gene Ontology (GO) Biological Process annotations, with host genes ranked by their absolute module membership (|kME|) for the correlated host module (ME10). Dot plots show the 21 most significantly enriched GO terms (Benjamini–Hochberg-adjusted p < 0.05). The normalised enrichment score (NES) indicates the strength of enrichment, dot size represents the number of leading-edge genes contributing to each term, and colour indicates the adjusted p-value (−log₁₀ FDR).

# Functional enrichment analysis revealed that host module ME10, which was correlated with microbial module ME1, was significantly enriched in biological processes associated with digestion, intestinal absorption, ion transport and bicarbonate transport (Fig. X).


```{r}

# ============================================================
# HOST: GSEA OF CO2-ASSOCIATED MODULES
# ME13, ME3, ME24
# ============================================================
# Host modules correlated with CO2 condition
host_modules_to_test <- c("13", "3", "24")

# ============================================================
# 1. PREPARE GENE-LEVEL ANNOTATION MAPPING
# ============================================================

annotations <- annotations %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = str_remove(query_name, "\\.t\\d+$")
  )

# GO BP background
host_universe_GO <- intersect(
  str_remove(colnames(datExpr_host), "\\.t\\d+$"),
  unique(TERM2GENE_BP$gene)
)

cat(
  "Host WGCNA genes with GO BP annotations:",
  length(host_universe_GO), "\n"
)

# ============================================================
# 2. RUN GSEA FOR EACH HOST MODULE
# ============================================================

host_GSEA_results <- bind_rows(

  lapply(host_modules_to_test, function(module_id) {

    ME_name <- paste0("ME", module_id)

    if (!ME_name %in% colnames(host_ME)) {
      stop("Cannot find ", ME_name, " in host_ME.")
    }

    cat("\nRunning GSEA for", ME_name, "\n")

    # Calculate kME for every WGCNA transcript
    kME_values <- as.numeric(
      cor(
        datExpr_host,
        host_ME[, ME_name],
        use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
      )
    )

    names(kME_values) <- colnames(datExpr_host)

    # Convert transcript IDs to gene IDs
    host_rank_df <- tibble(
      Transcript = names(kME_values),
      kME = kME_values
    ) %>%
      filter(is.finite(kME)) %>%
      mutate(
        Gene = str_remove(Transcript, "\\.t\\d+$")
      ) %>%
      filter(Gene %in% host_universe_GO) %>%
      group_by(Gene) %>%
      summarise(
        abs_kME = max(abs(kME), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      filter(is.finite(abs_kME)) %>%
      arrange(desc(abs_kME))

    # Ranked gene list
    geneList_host <- setNames(
      host_rank_df$abs_kME,
      host_rank_df$Gene
    )

    geneList_host <- sort(
      geneList_host,
      decreasing = TRUE
    )

    cat(
      "Genes in ranked list:",
      length(geneList_host), "\n"
    )

    if (length(geneList_host) < 10) {
      warning(
        "Too few mapped genes for ", ME_name,
        ". Check gene ID matching."
      )
      return(NULL)
    }

    if (anyDuplicated(names(geneList_host))) {
      stop("Duplicate gene IDs in ranked list for ", ME_name)
    }

    # Run GSEA
    gsea_result <- clusterProfiler::GSEA(
      geneList = geneList_host,
      TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE_BP,
      TERM2NAME = TERM2NAME_BP,
      minGSSize = 5,
      maxGSSize = 500,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff = 1,
      verbose = FALSE,
      seed = TRUE
    )

    if (is.null(gsea_result)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    result_df <- as.data.frame(gsea_result)

    if (nrow(result_df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    result_df %>%
      mutate(
        Host_module = ME_name
      )

  })
)

# ============================================================
# 3. INSPECT AND EXPORT RESULTS
# ============================================================

if (nrow(host_GSEA_results) > 0) {

  host_GSEA_results <- host_GSEA_results %>%
    mutate(
      Host_module = factor(
        Host_module,
        levels = paste0("ME", host_modules_to_test)
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(Host_module, p.adjust)

  host_GSEA_sig <- host_GSEA_results %>%
    filter(p.adjust < 0.05)

  cat(
    "\nSignificant GO BP terms:",
    nrow(host_GSEA_sig), "\n"
  )

  print(
    host_GSEA_sig %>%
      select(
        Host_module,
        ID,
        Description,
        setSize,
        enrichmentScore,
        NES,
        pvalue,
        p.adjust
      )
  )

  write.csv(
    host_GSEA_results,
    "Host_CO2_associated_modules_GO_BP_GSEA.csv",
    row.names = FALSE
  )

} else {

  host_GSEA_sig <- tibble()

  message("No GSEA results returned.")

}

# ============================================================
# 4. PREPARE PLOT DATA
# ============================================================

if (nrow(host_GSEA_sig) > 0) {

  plot_data <- host_GSEA_sig %>%

    # Select top 21 significant terms per module
    group_by(Host_module) %>%
    slice_min(
      order_by = p.adjust,
      n = 15,
      with_ties = FALSE
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%

    mutate(
      Description = str_wrap(Description, width = 40),

      LeadingEdgeSize = vapply(
        strsplit(
          ifelse(
            is.na(core_enrichment),
            "",
            core_enrichment
          ),
          "/",
          fixed = TRUE
        ),
        function(x) sum(nzchar(x)),
        integer(1)
      ),

      Plot_label = paste0(
        Description,
        " [",
        ID,
        "]"
      )
    ) %>%

    # Set panel order and term order
    arrange(Host_module, NES) %>%
    mutate(
      Host_module = factor(
        Host_module,
        levels = paste0("ME", host_modules_to_test)
      ),
      Plot_label = factor(
        Plot_label,
        levels = unique(Plot_label)
      )
    )

  # ============================================================
  # 5. THREE-PANEL GSEA DOT PLOT
  # ============================================================

  p_host_GSEA <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = NES,
      y = Plot_label
    )
  ) +

    geom_point(
      aes(
        size = LeadingEdgeSize,
        colour = -log10(p.adjust)
      ),
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +

    facet_wrap(
      ~ Host_module,
      nrow = 1,
      scales = "free_y",
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_colour_gradient(
      low = "#67A9CF",
      high = "#D73027",
      name = expression(-log[10](FDR))
    ) +

    scale_size_continuous(
      range = c(2, 8),
      name = "Leading-edge genes"
    ) +

    labs(
      x = "Normalised enrichment score (NES)",
      y = NULL,
      title = "Biological processes associated with CO2-correlated host modules",
      subtitle = "GO Biological Process GSEA ranked by absolute module membership"
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        colour = "black",
        size = 8
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        colour = "black"
      ),

      ),

  print(p_host_GSEA)

  # ============================================================
  # 6. SAVE SVG
  # ============================================================

  ggsave(
    filename = "WGCNA/Host_CO2_correlated_modules_GO_BP_GSEA.svg",
    plot = p_host_GSEA,
    device = "svg",
    width = 15,
    height = 6,

} else {

  message("No significant GO BP terms to plot.")

}

```{r}
# Extract module eigengenes and assign CO2 condition
module_site_data <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(host_ME),
  ME13 = host_ME[, "ME13"],
  ME24 = host_ME[, "ME24"]
) %>%
  mutate(
    Site = ifelse(grepl("^C", Sample), "Reference", "Elevated CO2")
  )

# Summarise mean eigengene values by condition
module_site_summary <- module_site_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ME13, ME24),
    names_to = "Module",
    values_to = "Eigengene"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Module, Site) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Eigengene, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Eigengene, na.rm = TRUE),
    N = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(module_site_summary)

# Calculate direction of the difference
module_site_direction <- module_site_summary %>%
  select(Module, Site, Mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Site, values_from = Mean) %>%
  mutate(
    Difference = `Elevated CO2` - Reference,
    Direction = ifelse(
      Difference > 0,
      "Higher in Elevated CO2",
      "Higher in Reference"
    )
  )

print(module_site_direction)

# Plot ME10 genes
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1. DESeq2 results: Elevated CO2 vs Reference
# ============================================================

de_gene_df <- as.data.frame(res_host_CO2) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Transcript") %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = str_remove(Transcript, "\\.t\\d+$")
  ) %>%
  select(Gene, log2FoldChange, stat, pvalue, padj) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  slice_min(
    order_by = padj,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE,
    na_rm = TRUE
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# ============================================================
# 2. Extract ALL genes belonging to host module ME10
# ============================================================

ME10_transcripts <- colnames(datExpr_host)[
  host_net$colors == 10
]

ME10_genes <- unique(
  str_remove(ME10_transcripts, "\\.t\\d+$")
)

genes_to_plot <- ME10_genes

cat("ME10 transcripts:", length(ME10_transcripts), "\n")
cat("Unique ME10 genes:", length(genes_to_plot), "\n")


# ============================================================
# 3. Extract variance-stabilised expression
# ============================================================

vst_mat <- assay(vsd_host)

# Extract gene IDs and average transcript expression per gene
vst_df <- as.data.frame(vst_mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Transcript") %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = str_remove(Transcript, "\\.t\\d+$")
  )

sample_ids <- colnames(vst_mat)

gene_expression <- vst_df %>%
  select(Gene, all_of(sample_ids)) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(sample_ids), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(Gene %in% genes_to_plot)

expression_mat <- gene_expression %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("\nExpression matrix before sample matching:\n")
print(dim(expression_mat))


# ============================================================
# 4. Match samples and order by condition
# ============================================================

vst_sample_ids <- data.frame(
  SampleID = colnames(vst_mat),
  UrchinID = str_extract(
    colnames(vst_mat),
    "(?<=_)[CH]\\d+(?=_)"
  )
)

# Make sure metadata IDs are character and consistent
metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    UrchinID = trimws(as.character(UrchinID)),
    condition = trimws(as.character(condition))
  )

sample_annotation <- vst_sample_ids %>%
  left_join(
    metadata %>%
      select(UrchinID, condition) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "UrchinID"
  )

cat("\nUnmatched samples:\n")
print(sample_annotation %>% filter(is.na(condition)))

# Keep matched samples and order by condition
sample_annotation <- sample_annotation %>%
  filter(!is.na(condition)) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(
      condition,
      levels = c("Reference", "Elevated CO2")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(condition, UrchinID)

# Reorder expression matrix to match annotation
expression_mat <- expression_mat[
  ,
  sample_annotation$SampleID,
  drop = FALSE
]

rownames(sample_annotation) <- sample_annotation$SampleID

sample_annotation <- sample_annotation %>%
  select(condition)

cat("\nSamples per condition:\n")
print(table(sample_annotation$condition, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nExpression matrix dimensions after matching:\n")
print(dim(expression_mat))

cat("\nAnnotation dimensions:\n")
print(dim(sample_annotation))

# Stop if samples have not been retained correctly
stopifnot(ncol(expression_mat) == nrow(sample_annotation))
stopifnot(ncol(expression_mat) > 0)


# ============================================================
# 5. Clean expression matrix and calculate Z-scores
# ============================================================

expression_mat <- expression_mat[
  apply(expression_mat, 1, function(x) all(is.finite(x))),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

gene_sd <- apply(expression_mat, 1, sd)

expression_mat <- expression_mat[
  is.finite(gene_sd) & gene_sd > 0,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

cat("\nVariable ME10 genes retained:\n")
print(nrow(expression_mat))

if (nrow(expression_mat) < 2) {
  stop("Fewer than two variable genes remain. Check the expression matrix.")
}

# Row-wise Z-scores across all individual urchins
expression_z <- t(scale(t(expression_mat)))


# ============================================================
# 6. Add DESeq2 annotation
# ============================================================

de_annotation <- tibble(
  Gene = rownames(expression_z)
) %>%
  left_join(
    de_gene_df %>%
      mutate(
        CO2_response = case_when(
          !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0 ~
            "Higher under elevated CO2",
          !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0 ~
            "Higher under reference",
          TRUE ~ "Not significant"
        )
      ) %>%
      select(Gene, CO2_response),
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CO2_response = coalesce(
      CO2_response,
      "No DESeq2 result"
    )
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene")



# ============================================================
# 7. Plot heatmap
# ============================================================

# Condition colours
annotation_colors <- list(
  condition = c(
    "Reference" = "#2C728E",
    "Elevated CO2" = "#D4476C"
  )
)

# Z-score colours
z_score_colors <- colorRampPalette(
  c("#2e2eff", "#ffffff", "#ff0902")
)(100)

n_reference <- sum(sample_annotation$condition == "Reference")

svglite(
  "WGCNA/ME10_all_genes_heatmap.svg",
  width = 10,
  height = 7
)

pheatmap(
  expression_z,
  scale = "none",
  color = z_score_colors,
  breaks = seq(-2.5, 2.5, length.out = 101),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  annotation_col = sample_annotation,
  annotation_row = de_annotation,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  show_rownames = nrow(expression_z) <= 100,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  fontsize_row = 6,
  border_color = NA,
  gaps_col = if (n_reference > 0 &&
                 n_reference < ncol(expression_z)) n_reference else NULL,
  main = "Host module ME10: expression across CO2 conditions"
)

dev.off()

# ============================================================
# 8. Add functional annotations to ME10 genes
# ============================================================

gene_annotations <- annotations %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = str_remove(query_name, "\\.t\\d+$")
  ) %>%
  select(
    Gene,
    Preferred_name,
    Description
  ) %>%
  distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)


# ============================================================
# 9. Create annotated ME10 gene table
# ============================================================

ME10_gene_table <- tibble(
  Gene = ME10_genes
) %>%
  left_join(
    gene_annotations,
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    de_gene_df,
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CO2_response = case_when(
      !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0 ~
        "Higher under elevated CO2",
      !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0 ~
        "Higher under reference",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(padj)


# ============================================================
# 10. Extract significant ME10 genes
# ============================================================

ME10_significant_genes <- ME10_gene_table %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(padj)

View(ME10_significant_genes)

# Just plot ME_1 pathways

```{r}

# ============================================================
# KEGG FUNCTIONAL REPERTOIRE AND ENRICHMENT IN BACTERIAL ME1
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(KEGGREST)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)


# ============================================================
# 1. ASSIGN ORFs TO WGCNA MODULES
# ============================================================

micro_membership <- tibble(
  Transcript = colnames(datExpr_micro),
  WGCNA_module = as.character(micro_net$colors)
) %>%
  filter(WGCNA_module != "0")

# ORFs inherit the module of their parent transcript
orf_membership <- eggnog_micro %>%
  distinct(ORF) %>%
  mutate(
    Transcript = str_remove(ORF, "_[0-9]+$")
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    micro_membership,
    by = "Transcript"
  ) %>%
  distinct(ORF, WGCNA_module)

cat("\nORFs by WGCNA module:\n")
print(table(orf_membership$WGCNA_module))


# ============================================================
# 2. EXTRACT KO ANNOTATIONS FROM BACTERIAL ORFs
# ============================================================

orf_KO <- eggnog_micro %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(KEGG_ko),
    KEGG_ko != "-"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    KEGG_ko = str_replace_all(
      KEGG_ko,
      "\\s+",
      ""
    )
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(
    KEGG_ko,
    sep = ","
  ) %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      KEGG_ko,
      "^ko:K[0-9]{5}$"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    KO = str_remove(KEGG_ko, "^ko:")
  ) %>%
  distinct(ORF, KO) %>%
  inner_join(
    orf_membership,
    by = "ORF"
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    ORF,
    KO,
    WGCNA_module
  )

cat("\nAnnotated ORFs:", n_distinct(orf_KO$ORF), "\n")
cat("Unique KOs:", n_distinct(orf_KO$KO), "\n")


# ============================================================
# 3. RETRIEVE KEGG MODULE DEFINITIONS AND HIERARCHY
# ============================================================

# Retrieve KEGG module identifiers
kegg_modules <- KEGGREST::keggList("module")

module_ids <- names(kegg_modules) %>%
  str_remove("^md:") %>%
  unique()

module_ids <- module_ids[
  str_detect(module_ids, "^M[0-9]{5}$")
]

# KEGG REST accepts batches of up to 10 entries
module_batches <- split(
  module_ids,
  ceiling(seq_along(module_ids) / 10)
)

module_entries <- unlist(
  lapply(
    module_batches,
    function(ids) {
      KEGGREST::keggGet(
        paste0("md:", ids)
      )
    }
  ),
  recursive = FALSE
)

# Extract module name and broad/subclass hierarchy
module_info <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    module_entries,
    function(entry) {

      tibble(
        Module = str_remove(
          entry$ENTRY[1],
          "^md:"
        ),

        Name = paste(
          entry$NAME,
          collapse = " "
        ),

        Class = if (
          is.null(entry$CLASS)
        ) {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          paste(
            entry$CLASS,
            collapse = "; "
          )
        }
      )
    }
  )
) %>%
  distinct(Module, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Retrieve KO -> KEGG Module relationships
module_KO <- KEGGREST::keggLink(
  "ko",
  "module"
) %>%
  tibble(
    Module = names(.) %>%
      str_remove("^md:"),

    KO = unname(.) %>%
      str_remove("^ko:")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(Module, "^M[0-9]{5}$")
  ) %>%
  distinct(Module, KO) %>%
  inner_join(
    module_info,
    by = "Module"
  ) %>%
  distinct(Module, KO, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat(
  "\nKEGG pathway Modules retrieved:",
  n_distinct(module_KO$Module),
  "\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 4. DEFINE ME1 ORFs, BACKGROUND AND MODULE ORF SETS
# ============================================================

# Background:
# All KO-annotated ORFs assigned to non-grey WGCNA modules

universe_ORF <- orf_KO %>%
  distinct(ORF) %>%
  pull(ORF)

# Selected:
# KO-annotated ORFs assigned to ME1

selected_ORF <- orf_KO %>%
  filter(WGCNA_module == "1") %>%
  distinct(ORF) %>%
  pull(ORF)

# ME1 ORF-KO table
ME1_KOs <- orf_KO %>%
  filter(WGCNA_module == "1") %>%
  distinct(ORF, KO)

# Unique KOs represented in ME1
ME1_KO_set <- unique(ME1_KOs$KO)

# Assign ORFs to KEGG modules through their KOs
orf_module <- orf_KO %>%
  inner_join(
    module_KO,
    by = "KO"
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    ORF,
    Module,
    Name,
    Class
  )

# KEGG module-specific ORF sets
module_sets <- orf_module %>%
  filter(ORF %in% universe_ORF) %>%
  group_by(
    Module,
    Name,
    Class
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    ORFs = list(unique(ORF)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Background and selected sample sizes
N <- length(universe_ORF)
n <- length(intersect(selected_ORF, universe_ORF))

cat("\nBackground ORFs:", N, "\n")
cat("ME1 ORFs:", n, "\n")


# ============================================================
# 5. KEGG MODULE OVERREPRESENTATION TEST
# ============================================================

enrichment_ME1 <- bind_rows(

  lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(module_sets)),
    function(i) {

      pathway_ORF <- module_sets$ORFs[[i]]

      K <- length(
        intersect(pathway_ORF, universe_ORF)
      )

      k <- length(
        intersect(selected_ORF, pathway_ORF)
      )

      if (K < 3) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      tibble(
        Module = module_sets$Module[i],
        N_background = N,
        N_module_ORFs = K,
        N_selected_ORFs = n,
        N_overlap = k,

        Fold_enrichment = ifelse(
          k == 0,
          0,
          (k / n) / (K / N)
        ),

        pvalue = phyper(
          q = k - 1,
          m = K,
          n = N - K,
          k = n,
          lower.tail = FALSE
        )
      )
    }
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(
      pvalue,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(FDR)

# Significantly enriched KEGG modules
enrichment_sig_ME1 <- enrichment_ME1 %>%
  filter(FDR < 0.05)

cat(
  "\nSignificantly enriched KEGG Modules:",
  nrow(enrichment_sig_ME1),
  "\n"
)

print(
  enrichment_sig_ME1 %>%
    select(
      Module,
      N_overlap,
      N_module_ORFs,
      Fold_enrichment,
      pvalue,
      FDR
    )
)


# ============================================================
# 6. CALCULATE KO REPRESENTATION IN ME1
# ============================================================

ME1_module_summary <- module_KO %>%
  group_by(
    Module,
    Name,
    Class
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_KOs = n_distinct(KO),

    Observed_KOs = n_distinct(
      KO[KO %in% ME1_KO_set]
    ),

    KO_coverage = Observed_KOs / Total_KOs * 100,

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(KO_coverage))

View(ME1_module_summary)

# ============================================================
# 7. COUNT UNIQUE ME1 ORFs CONTRIBUTING TO EACH MODULE
# ============================================================

ME1_module_ORF_counts <- ME1_KOs %>%
  inner_join(
    module_KO,
    by = "KO"
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Module,
    ORF
  ) %>%
  count(
    Module,
    name = "N_ORFs"
  )


# ============================================================
# 8. PREPARE PLOT DATA AND ADD ENRICHMENT ASTERISKS
# ============================================================

ME1_module_plotdata <- ME1_module_summary %>%

  # Exclude selected disease- and organism-specific modules
  filter(
    !str_detect(
      str_to_lower(
        paste(Name, Class)
      ),
      "alzheimer|cancer|tumour|tumor|longevity.*worm|tuberculosis"
    )
  ) %>%

  # Retain sufficiently represented KEGG modules
  filter(
    Total_KOs >= 3,
    KO_coverage >= 20
  ) %>%

  left_join(
    ME1_module_ORF_counts,
    by = "Module"
  ) %>%

  # Join statistical enrichment results
  left_join(
    enrichment_ME1 %>%
      select(
        Module,
        Fold_enrichment,
        pvalue,
        FDR,
        N_overlap
      ),
    by = "Module"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    N_ORFs = replace_na(N_ORFs, 0),

    Enriched = !is.na(FDR) & FDR < 0.05,

    # Extract broad KEGG functional class
    KEGG_Class = str_trim(
      str_split_i(Class, ";", 2)
    ),

    KEGG_Class = factor(
      KEGG_Class,
      levels = c(
        "Amino acid metabolism",
        "Carbohydrate metabolism",
        "Energy metabolism",
        "Glycan metabolism",
        "Metabolism of cofactors and vitamins",
        "Nucleotide metabolism"
      )
    ),

    # Add asterisk to significantly enriched modules
    Label = paste0(
      Module,
      " | ",
      Name,
      ifelse(Enriched, " *", "")
    )
  ) %>%

  arrange(KO_coverage) %>%

  mutate(
    Label = factor(
      Label,
      levels = Label
    )
  )


# Inspect plot data
View(
  ME1_module_plotdata %>%
    select(
      Module,
      Name,
      KEGG_Class,
      Observed_KOs,
      Total_KOs,
      KO_coverage,
      N_ORFs,
      Fold_enrichment,
      FDR,
      Enriched
    )
)


# ============================================================
# 9. PLOT ME1 FUNCTIONAL REPERTOIRE — LOLLIPOP
# ============================================================

ME1_repertoire_plot <- ggplot(
  ME1_module_plotdata,
  aes(

print(ME1_repertoire_plot)


# ============================================================
# 10. SAVE SVG

ggsave(

Each point represents a KEGG module, with the x-axis indicating the percentage of its constituent KOs represented in ME1 (KO coverage). Only KEGG modules containing at least three KOs and showing ≥25% KO representation were included. Point size indicates the number of unique ME1 open reading frames (ORFs) associated with each KEGG module.


```{r}
# ============================================================
# TEST WHETHER HOST–MICROBIOME MODULE COUPLING
# DIFFERS BETWEEN REFERENCE AND ELEVATED CO2
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Align metadata and correctly encode treatment
# ------------------------------------------------------------

traits_aligned <- traits[
  rownames(host_ME_bio),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

coupling_data <- data.frame(
  Condition = factor(
    traits_aligned$Condition,
    levels = c(0, 1),
    labels = c("Reference", "Elevated CO2")
  )
)

# Check
table(coupling_data$Condition)

stopifnot(
  all(table(coupling_data$Condition) > 0)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Test every host–microbiome module pair
# ------------------------------------------------------------

coupling_results <- map_dfr(
  colnames(host_ME_bio),
  function(host_module) {

    map_dfr(
      colnames(micro_ME_bio),
      function(micro_module) {

        dat <- coupling_data %>%
          mutate(
            HostME = host_ME_bio[, host_module],
            MicroME = micro_ME_bio[, micro_module]
          )

        fit <- lm(
          MicroME ~ HostME * Condition,
          data = dat
        )

        coefficients <- summary(fit)$coefficients

        interaction_term <- grep(
          "HostME:Condition",
          rownames(coefficients),
          value = TRUE
        )

        tibble(
          HostModule = host_module,
          MicroModule = micro_module,

          # Host-ME slope under Reference
          Reference_slope =
            coefficients["HostME", "Estimate"],

          # Difference in slope under Elevated CO2
          CO2_slope_difference =
            coefficients[interaction_term, "Estimate"],

          # Host-ME slope under Elevated CO2
          Elevated_slope =
            coefficients["HostME", "Estimate"] +
            coefficients[interaction_term, "Estimate"],

          Interaction_P =
            coefficients[interaction_term, "Pr(>|t|)"]
        )
      }
    )
  }
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Correct for multiple testing
# ------------------------------------------------------------

coupling_results <- coupling_results %>%
  mutate(
    Interaction_FDR = p.adjust(
      Interaction_P,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Interaction_FDR)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Identify treatment-dependent associations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

coupling_results %>%
  filter(Interaction_FDR < 0.05)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Specifically inspect ME10 x ME1
# ------------------------------------------------------------

coupling_results %>%
  filter(
    HostModule == "ME10",
    MicroModule == "ME1"
  )

```

```{r}

# ============================================================
# GO GSEA FOR HOST MODULES ASSOCIATED WITH CO2 TREATMENT
# ME24, ME3, ME13
# ============================================================
# Modules associated with CO2 treatment
host_modules_CO2 <- c("ME24", "ME3", "ME13")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Run GSEA for each module
# ------------------------------------------------------------

host_GSEA_CO2 <- list()

for (ME_name in host_modules_CO2) {

  # Calculate module membership (kME)
  kME_values <- as.numeric(
    cor(
      datExpr_host,
      host_ME[, ME_name],
      use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
    )
  )

  names(kME_values) <- colnames(datExpr_host)

  # Rank genes by absolute module membership
  geneList <- sort(
    abs(kME_values),
    decreasing = TRUE
  )

  # Convert transcript IDs to gene IDs
  names(geneList) <- str_remove(
    names(geneList),
    "\\.t\\d+$"
  )

  # Remove duplicate gene IDs
  geneList <- geneList[!duplicated(names(geneList))]

  # Run GSEA
  gsea_result <- GSEA(
    geneList = geneList,
    TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE_BP,
    TERM2NAME = TERM2NAME_BP,
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    minGSSize = 10,
    maxGSSize = 500,
    verbose = FALSE
  )

  # Store results
  host_GSEA_CO2[[ME_name]] <- as.data.frame(gsea_result) %>%
    mutate(Host_module = ME_name)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Combine results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

host_GSEA_CO2_results <- bind_rows(
  host_GSEA_CO2
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Significant GO terms
# ------------------------------------------------------------

host_GSEA_CO2_sig <- host_GSEA_CO2_results %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(Host_module, p.adjust)

# View results
View(host_GSEA_CO2_sig)

write.csv(
  host_GSEA_CO2_sig,
  "WGCNA/Host_CO2_Module_GO_GSEA_Significant.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
# It seems like the host modules which correlate with CO2 (but not microbes) are related to growth, division, regulation, sensing etc. NOT metabolism, digestion etc. So, the only module which strongly correlated with microbes is stuff to do with digestion and metabolism. Makes sense!

# Functional enrichment analysis of host modules associated with CO₂ treatment revealed distinct but overlapping biological signatures. ME3, which was positively associated with Elevated CO₂, was enriched in processes related to DNA replication, DNA repair, meiotic and mitotic cell cycles, chromosome segregation and microtubule organisation. ME24, also positively associated with Elevated CO₂, exhibited a more restricted enrichment profile, including centrosomal protein localisation, RNA processing, centriole assembly and glucose catabolism. In contrast, ME13, which was negatively associated with Elevated CO₂, was predominantly enriched in processes associated with cilium and axoneme assembly, microtubule-based movement, cell projection organisation and vesicle-mediated transport and secretion. Collectively, these modules highlighted transcriptional patterns associated with cellular replication, microtubule organisation and intracellular transport, with distinct functional signatures corresponding to positive and negative associations with elevated CO₂.

```{r}

# ============================================================
# KEGG MODULE ENRICHMENT IN MICROBIAL WGCNA MODULE ME2
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. ME2 ORFs and background
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ME2_ORFs <- orf_KO %>%
  filter(WGCNA_module == "2") %>%
  distinct(ORF)

background_ORFs <- orf_KO %>%
  distinct(ORF)

N <- n_distinct(background_ORFs$ORF)
n <- n_distinct(ME2_ORFs$ORF)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Calculate KEGG module enrichment
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ME2_module_summary <- module_KO %>%
  group_by(Module) %>%
  summarise(

    Total_KOs = n_distinct(KO),

    Observed_KOs = n_distinct(
      KO[KO %in% ME2_KOs$KO]
    ),

    .groups = "drop"

  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(

    # Background ORFs encoding KOs in this KEGG module
    Background_ORFs = n_distinct(
      orf_KO$ORF[
        orf_KO$KO %in%
          module_KO$KO[module_KO$Module == Module]
      ]
    ),

    # ME2 ORFs encoding KOs in this KEGG module
    Observed_ORFs = n_distinct(
      ME2_KOs$ORF[
        ME2_KOs$KO %in%
          module_KO$KO[module_KO$Module == Module]
      ]
    ),

    # Hypergeometric enrichment
    Pvalue = phyper(
      Observed_ORFs - 1,
      Background_ORFs,
      N - Background_ORFs,
      n,
      lower.tail = FALSE
    ),

    Fold_enrichment = (
      Observed_ORFs / n
    ) / (
      Background_ORFs / N
    )

  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(Pvalue, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(FDR)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Significant modules
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ME2_module_sig <- ME2_module_summary %>%
  filter(FDR < 0.05)

View(ME2_module_sig)

```

```{r}

# ============================================================
# MICROBIAL ME2 FUNCTIONAL REPERTOIRE
# Top KEGG modules by KO coverage
# ============================================================
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Summarise KO representation in ME2
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ME2_functional_repertoire <- module_KO %>%
  group_by(Module) %>%
  summarise(

    Total_KOs = n_distinct(KO),

    Observed_KOs = n_distinct(
      KO[KO %in% ME2_KOs$KO]
    ),

    .groups = "drop"

  ) %>%
  mutate(
    KO_coverage = Observed_KOs / Total_KOs
  ) %>%
  filter(Observed_KOs > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(KO_coverage))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Add number of ME2 ORFs assigned to each KEGG module
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ME2_functional_repertoire <- ME2_functional_repertoire %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    N_ORFs = n_distinct(
      ME2_KOs$ORF[
        ME2_KOs$KO %in%
          module_KO$KO[module_KO$Module == Module]
      ]
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Keep top 20 KEGG modules
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ME2_functional_repertoire_top20 <- ME2_functional_repertoire %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = KO_coverage,
    n = 20,
    with_ties = TRUE
  )

# ============================================================
# ADD KEGG MODULE DESCRIPTIONS TO ME2 TABLE
# ============================================================


# Retrieve KEGG module names
kegg_module_names <- KEGGREST::keggList("module")

kegg_module_names <- tibble(
  Module = sub("^md:", "", names(kegg_module_names)),
  Description = unname(kegg_module_names)
)

# Join descriptions to ME2 functional repertoire
ME2_functional_repertoire_top20 <- ME2_functional_repertoire_top20 %>%
  left_join(kegg_module_names, by = "Module") %>%
  select(
    Module,
    Description,
    Total_KOs,
    Observed_KOs,
    KO_coverage,
    N_ORFs
  )

# View
View(ME2_functional_repertoire_top20)

```
